mapper.sql: id, client_code, client_name, contract_code, contract_name, periods, plan_date, rent_amount, principal_amount, interest_amount, principal_tax, interest_tax, outflow_amount, planned_interest, planned_principal, cash_flow, opening_amortized_cost, ending_amortized_cost, actual_daily_rate, rental_income, service_fee_amortization_rate, service_fee_amortization_income, xirr_rate, actual_repayment_date, actual_repayment_principal_balance, actual_repayment_principal_amount, actual_repayment_interes_balance, actual_repayment_interes_amount, recapture_status, overdue_earnings, comment, overdue_days, process_status, submit_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, source_irr_rate, adjustment_amount, change_after_ending_amortized_cost, change_after_ending_amortized_cost
mapper.select:
select a.* from eg_repayment_plan_his a, ( select contract_code, max(version) version from eg_repayment_plan_his where del_flag = '0'
and contract_code in
#{item}
group by contract_code ) b where a.version = b.version and a.contract_code = b.contract_code order by contract_code,plan_date

select a.* from eg_repayment_plan_his a, ( select contract_code, max(version) version from eg_repayment_plan_his where del_flag = '0' and to_char(change_date,'YYYY-MM') = to_char(to_date(#{param},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM') group by contract_code ) b where a.version = b.version and a.contract_code = b.contract_code order by contract_code,plan_date
select version from eg_repayment_plan_his where contract_code = #{contractCode} order by id desc limit 1

select contract_code, org_id, sum(coalesce(planned_principal, 0)) as planned_principal, sum(coalesce(planned_interest, 0)) as planned_interest from eg_repayment_plan_his where 1 = 1 and "version" in( select max(t."version") from eg_repayment_plan_his t where 1 = 1 and t.contract_code = #{param.contractCode} and t.org_id = #{param.orgId} and to_char(change_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.planDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') ) and contract_code = #{param.contractCode} and org_id = #{param.orgId} and to_char(change_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.planDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') group by contract_code, org_id
